ok thanks
Used the chat-interview skill
Before you go, one thing: back in October you were thinking about a refund on the B30. What made you decide to keep it in the end?

I did like the product but was very disappointed with the recurring delays.  My original delivery was supposed to be early September and it kept getting pushed ahead.  I appreciated your offer of a refund of some of my fee back to my credit card - it showed good faith.  I understand you likely aren't a huge company and I admire the entrepreneurship but I'm sure you can understand the passionate community you are serving - we just want our stuff!

That's fair, and thank you for being straight with me. You were told early September and you're only now getting a label in November. That's on us, not you.

What would have made the wait easier: more frequent updates, or fewer dates that we didn't keep?

Yeah I'm not sure what would have been better.  Actually, the idea of periodic refunds to original method of payment for missed deadlines would be a great idea! Delivery pushed back a week? $10 immediate refund, a month? $50.  Some kind of automatic refund of a certain amount for missed deadlines would be a great selling feature to future buyers!

That's a concrete idea, and I'll make sure it gets passed on. I can't promise it'll become policy, but it's the kind of thing that's worth hearing.

One last question: if a guarantee like that had been on the page in July, would it have changed whether you pre-ordered, or mainly how the wait felt?

no it wouldn't have changed it as I've never encountered such delays with other vendors but now realizing supply chains and quality control can delay things, it would have given me some reassurance that I'm dealing with a legitimate company - any company giving money back to me can't be all that bad!

Thanks, Neelesh. That's really useful, especially the part about money back being a sign of a legitimate company.

Your B30 is labelled and ready to go. The tracking link will update once the carrier picks it up. I hope it was worth the wait.
me too!
Enjoy it when it lands, Neelesh. If anything's not right once it's running, just message us here.
